text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eeehhh~?! Kawakami-senpai!
Are you for real for real~?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed! It's from the PuriFi series you love so much, Pandora-san...
'PuriFi ☆ Heartful Dream'!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The building used as the model for the resort hotel in episode 33 is right in our neighborhood!
...Ah, here it is!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
This photo looks exactly like the spot where the PuriFi girls fought!
My excitement is completely through the roof~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No way! That's so nostalgic~~!
I remember this place super clearly!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh! There's a scene I used to love so much back then, maybe we could recreate it here!
Hey, hey, come join me, se~npa~i♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, so good~~♡
Oh man, I could totally drink this forever.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Plus, this super-cute dress♪
The PuriFi girls were wearing outfits like this too, right~? Total love♡

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! How nostalgic.
In the anime, everyone was enjoying a vacation just like this!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, this isn't what I imagined at all~~~?!
I totally thought we'd recreate an intense, fiery scene like the underwater battle in the pool...!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Mmh~☆ I used to look up to this so much~.
Like being a mature older girl, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ahaha☆ Come to think of it, I used to imitate them all the time. Like, 'I wanna sparkle like this too~!'

text_block_list.name: Young Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehehehe~♡ Look, look, Papa~!
I have so many accessories, pretty, right~♪

text_block_list.name: Young Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, take me somewhere nice~☆
I wanna have a super-gorgeous holiday just like PuriFi♡

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...! My, my, my~!
So that's how it was, you looked up to the PuriFi girls just like that...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I understand that feeling completely!
I used to imitate them too!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
For real, you too, Kawakami-senpai?!
Hey hey, what kind of things did you do?
Kids' cosmetics are an absolute classic, right~☆

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Special move training!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how nostalgic~.
The 'Princess Accel Spin'...
I failed at it so many times back then.

text_block_list.name: Young Kawakami
text_block_list.text:
*Pant*... *pant*...! Not yet!
I have to spin... even faster...!

text_block_list.name: Young Kawakami
text_block_list.text: Just like PuriFi... I'll smash right through my limits~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! That's insane!
You're a hardcore PuriFi recreation fanatic, aren't you!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Fufu, both you and I were so obsessed with PuriFi that we longed to 'become just like them'...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Even if the shape of our admiration was different, our love for it is the very same!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Pandora-san,
please indulge me in recreating my favorite scene next!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The transformation scene with dresses fluttering in the wind!
It is ridiculously, extraordinarily cool~~~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No way, I might actually remember that one~!
I'm in, I'm in! I wanna be the blonde girl~♡
One day, while walking down the hallway...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, Senpa~i♡ That vacation the other day was absolute love~♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Transforming into PuriFi, striking signature poses~? PuriFi is just the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I am truly honored~!
...Although, nearly smashing the hotel wall was taking things a bit too far...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for going along with me the other day...!
I am deeply, truly grateful~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No prob at a~ll☆
Chatting about PuriFi was super nostalgic, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Next time, wanna do that~?
A PuriFi watch party!
It'll be total love for sure~♡
